verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Why North Korea's Kim Jong Un doesn't need a US deal
title.zh: 朝鲜的金正恩为何不需要与美国达成协议

summary.en: Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，平壤在得到鼓舞后正在加速其核计划，并巩固与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。

body.en:
Donald Trump's overtures to North Korea's dictator have gone nowhere, with an emboldened Pyongyang accelerating its nuclear program and solidifying alliances with Russia and China.

In August, US President Donald Trump revived a charm offensive aimed at Pyongyang  by drastically scaling back joint US military exercises with South Korea and heaping praise on North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The US president said the North Korean dictator "has always treated me with great respect."

North Korea's response to Trump's overtures has been markedly less enthusiastic, ranging from firing a barrage of missiles to publicly denying Trump's claims that Kim has responded "very positively" to a request for talks.

This week, as the US and South Korea, along with Japan, kicked off a five-day military drill, there was no mention of any pullback from Washington, nor any sign of diplomatic progress with Pyongyang.

Instead, Kim on Monday commissioned a naval destroyer, while again emphasizing North Korea must establish a "powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent" and strengthen "maritime defense." Kim also said North Korea would soon unveil a "significant" naval advancement.

Unlike the summit diplomacy of Trump's first term, Kim's dismissive stance comes at a time when North Korea has alternatives to a grand bargain with the United States.

"For Kim, the stakes are simply lower than they were in 2019. There is no longer the same sense of urgency in Pyongyang to get back to the negotiating table with Washington," Joon Ha Park, a correspondent at Korea Risk Group in Seoul, told DW.

"North Korea now has a treaty-based alliance with Moscow and is drawing closer to Beijing, while its military capabilities have expanded significantly. That's why a single reduction in ROK-US military exercises is not enough for Pyongyang to be swayed," he added, referring to military ties between South Korea and the US.

Park agrees that Kim is arguably in his strongest position since taking power in 2011.

Just six years ago, amid crippling sanctions and the coronavirus pandemic, an emotional Kim stood at the lectern marking the 75th anniversary of the Korean Workers' Party and expressed regret for having failed the North Korean people.

Fast forward to today, and North Korea's economy appears to be on a stronger footing . Estimates released last year by South Korea's central bank showed the economy expanded by 3.7% in 2024, its fastest rate of growth in eight years.

Kim has brought North Korea closer to Russia and China than the traditionally isolated country has been in decades. This week, both Moscow and Beijing sent messages marking North Korea's 78th founding anniversary and praising the strategic importance of their deepening partnerships with...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普对朝鲜独裁者的示好毫无进展，胆大妄为的平壤加速了核计划，并巩固了与俄罗斯和中国的联盟。 上个月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普大幅缩减美国与韩国的联合军演，并对朝鲜领导人金正恩大加赞扬，从而重新发起针对平壤的魅力攻势。美国总统表示，朝鲜独裁者“一直非常尊重我”。 朝鲜对特朗普提议的反应明显不那么热情，从发射一连串导弹到公开否认特朗普关于金正恩对会谈请求做出“非常积极”回应的说法。 本周，美国、韩国以及日本开始了为期五天的军事演习，但没有提到华盛顿有任何撤军，也没有任何与平壤取得外交进展的迹象。 相反，金正恩周一委托了一艘海军驱逐舰，同时再次强调朝鲜必须建立“强大而可靠的核战争威慑力量”并加强“海上防御”。金正恩还表示，朝鲜很快将公布一项“重大”海军进展。 与特朗普第一任期的峰会外交不同，金正恩的不屑一顾的立场是在朝鲜除了与美国达成大交易之外还有其他选择之际采取的。 “对金正恩来说，赌注比2019年要低。平壤不再有回到与华盛顿谈判桌的紧迫感，”首尔韩国风险集团记者Joon Ha Park告诉德国之声。 “朝鲜现在与莫斯科建立了基于条约的联盟，并且正在向北京靠拢，而其军事能力也显着增强。这就是为什么韩美军事演习的一次减少不足以让平壤动摇，”他在谈到韩国和美国之间的军事关系时补充道。 朴槿惠也同意，金正恩可以说是自 2011 年上台以来处于最有利的位置。 就在六年前，在严厉的制裁和冠状病毒大流行的背景下，金正恩情绪激动地站在纪念朝鲜劳动党成立75周年的讲台上，对辜负了朝鲜人民的期望表示遗憾。 快进到今天，朝鲜经济似乎已经站稳了脚跟。韩国央行去年发布的预测显示，2024年经济将增长3.7%，为八年来最快增速。 金正恩使朝鲜与俄罗斯和中国的关系比这个传统上孤立的国家几十年来更加接近。本周，莫斯科和北京都发出了纪念朝鲜成立 78 周年的信息，并赞扬了两国深化与朝鲜的伙伴关系的战略重要性……

reflection.en: The news highlights how Kim Jong Un's regime continues to advance its nuclear ambitions, seemingly unfazed by diplomatic overtures. Proverbs 28:15 warns that 'When the wicked rule, people groan.' This verse speaks to the inherent instability and suffering that can arise when power is wielded without accountability, as seen in the continued acceleration of...
reflection.zh: 新闻指出，金正恩政权似乎并未受到外交示好的影响，仍在推进其核野心。箴言 28:15 警告说：“恶人在位，人就叹息。”这节经文呼应了当权力在缺乏问责的情况下被滥用时，可能产生的固有不稳定和苦难，正如在国际关注下朝鲜核计划的持续加速所见。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: China angered by Taiwan VP's visit to EU democracy forum
title.zh: 中国对台湾副总统访问欧盟民主论坛表示愤怒

summary.en: Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China, and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.
summary.zh: 北京就台湾高级官员访问民主会议一事向意大利和欧盟提出抗议。欧盟正在处理与中国的敏感问题，而台湾高级官员的访问非常罕见。

body.en:
Beijing has lodged a complaint with Italy and the EU over top Taiwanese officials visiting a democracy conference. The EU is navigating contentious issues with China and high-ranking Taiwanese visits are rare.

China was angered by Italy and the EU on Friday, lodging "solemn ‌representations" with both after news broke that high-ranking Taiwanese officials had traveled to the bloc to attend an annual democracy summit.

Beijing's Foreign Ministry said it firmly opposes official interactions of any form with Taiwan by nations who have ties with China .

Solemn ‌representations is a literal translation of a Chinese term expressing diplomatic discontent. 

At issue is a visit by Vice President Hsiao Bi-khim and Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung, both of whom were welcomed to the Ventotene Conference for Freedom and Democracy in Italy.

China sees democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory, which it has  vowed to "reunite" with the mainland . 

Beijing has previously blasted Hsiao as an "independence diehard" and has criticized her Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) as a separatist outfit.

Taiwan's government has not sought formal independence but Beijing has, nevertheless, threatened to take the island by military force.

European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno announced Hsiao and Lin's attendance at the conference early Friday morning, adding that news of the visit had been kept under wraps until they arrived for safety reasons.

The EU's Picierno, who called the visit a "very important message," was defiant on Friday, saying, "No one can decide who is hosted in Ventotene and who is not," and calling out the Chinese "regime" for seeking to interfere. 

Though Taiwanese foreign ministers travel abroad, it is rare for an official as high-ranking as the vice president to visit nations with ties to Beijing for fear of fallout for host countries.

Other prominent pro-democracy advocates such as Russian Kremlin critic Yulia Navalnaya , the wife of the late Alexei Navalny, and Belarus opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya are also in attendance. 

Italy, like most nations, is not among Taiwan's 12 formal diplomatic allies, although the Vatican is.

Italy's Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani will not meet with the visiting Taiwanese officials.

The EU is walking a fine line between democratic support for Taiwan and relations with China.

Beijing's support for Russia in its ongoing invasion of Ukraine — which also prompted Taiwan to seek closer ties with the EU in 2022 — has been a thorn in the side of EU nations and in Brussels.

body.zh: 北京已就台湾高级官员参观民主会议向意大利和欧盟提出投诉。欧盟正在处理与中国有争议的问题，台湾高层访问很少。 周五，意大利和欧盟激怒了中国，在台湾高级官员前往欧盟参加年度民主峰会的消息传出后，中国向意大利和欧盟提出了“严正交涉”。 北京外交部表示，坚决反对与中国有联系的国家与台湾进行任何形式的官方互动。 严正交涉是表达外交不满的中文术语的直译。 争论的焦点是副主席萧美琴和外交部长林家龙的访问，他们两人都受到了意大利文托泰内自由民主会议的欢迎。 中国将民主治理的台湾视为自己的领土，并发誓要与大陆“统一”。 北京此前曾抨击萧是“独立顽固分子”，并批评她所在的民进党（DPP）是分裂主义组织。 台湾政府并未寻求正式独立，但北京却威胁要用武力夺取台湾。 欧洲议会副主席皮娜·皮切尔诺周五凌晨宣布萧和林出席会议，并补充说，出于安全原因，在他们抵达之前，此次访问的消息一直处于保密状态。 欧盟委员皮切尔诺称这次访问是一个“非常重要的信息”，他在周五挑衅地说，“没有人可以决定谁在文托泰内接待，谁不接待”，并指责中国“政权”试图干涉。 尽管台湾外长经常出国访问，但像副总统这样的高级官员很少访问与北京有联系的国家，因为担心对东道国造成影响。 其他著名的民主倡导者，如俄罗斯克里姆林宫批评家尤利娅·纳瓦尔纳亚（已故阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼的妻子）和白俄罗斯反对派领导人斯维亚特兰娜·齐哈努斯卡娅也出席了会议。 与大多数国家一样，意大利并不在台湾的 12 个正式外交盟友之列，但梵蒂冈却在其中。 意大利外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼不会会见来访的台湾官员。 欧盟在对台湾的民主支持和与中国的关系之间保持着微妙的平衡。 北京对俄罗斯持续入侵乌克兰的支持——这也促使台湾在 2022 年寻求与欧盟建立更紧密的关系——一直是欧盟国家和布鲁塞尔的眼中钉。 如果您依赖我们团队提供值得信赖的报告，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终看到...

reflection.en: Diplomatic tensions often arise from differing political views and national interests. In these moments, the call to live peaceably with all, as much as it depends on us, is a vital reminder for nations and individuals alike. May wisdom guide leaders toward de-escalation and mutual respect.
reflection.zh: 外交紧张局势常常源于不同的政治观点和国家利益。在这些时刻，尽我们所能与人和睦相处的呼吁，对国家和个人来说都是一个重要的提醒。愿智慧引导领导者走向缓和局势和相互尊重。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Hong Kong Tiananmen activists jailed for up to 7 years
title.zh: 香港天安门案活动人士被判处最高七年监禁

summary.en: Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were sentenced to between five and seven years in prison under Hong Kong's national security law for "incitement to subversion."
summary.zh: 三名组织纪念中国1989年致命天安门镇压活动的有组织民主活动人士，根据香港国安法被判处五年至七年监禁，罪名为“煽动颠覆”。

body.en:
Three pro-democracy activists who organized annual commemorations of China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown were charged under Hong Kong's Beijing-backed national security law.

A Hong Kong court on Friday sentenced three pro-democracy activists who organized annual vigils marking China's deadly 1989 Tiananmen crackdown to between five and seven years in prison under the city's national security law .

The three were convicted in August of "incitement to subversion" over their activities with the now-disbanded Hong Kong Alliance, which received a fine of HK$1.5 million ($191,304, €164,768). The alliance had organized annual Tiananmen vigils in Victoria Park.

Judges cited the group's call to "end one-party dictatorship," saying it challenged the legitimacy of Communist Party rule in the Chinese special administrative region. 

Lee and Chow denied the subversion charges under Hong Kong's controversial national security law. The defendants also insisted the alliance had not asked people to do anything illegal. 

The court rejected arguments that the defendants believed they were acting within the law given Hong ​Kong's freedoms of speech, which have been severely curtailed since Beijing imposed the law in 2020 following a crackdown mass pro-democracy protests the previous year.

The vigils, once a major annual event in Hong Kong, have been effectively banned under the law. 

Chow, a barrister who represented herself, raised both arms and waved at supporters as she was escorted out.

Her mother, Medina Chow, addressed her supporters saying, "For today's verdict, you do not need to be overly saddened. Do not lose heart. And above all, do not ​feel guilty."

The convictions have drawn criticism from foreign governments and rights groups.

"This sentencing is a triple tragedy: for the activists being unjustly punished; the survivors and victims of the Tiananmen crackdown itself; and the generations of Hongkongers denied the space to discuss one of the most consequential events in modern Chinese history," said Amnesty International's deputy regional director, Sarah Brooks.

Germany and France last month had condemned the verdict against Chow saying that "peaceful advocacy for human rights does not constitute a crime."

Among those arrested under the security law are pro-democracy former media tycoon Jimmy Lai and former student leader Joshua Wong .

body.zh: 三名民主活动人士因每年组织纪念 1989 年中国致命的天安门镇压活动而受到北京支持的香港国家安全法的指控。 香港一家法院周五根据香港国家安全法判处三名民主活动人士五年至七年监禁，这些活动人士每年组织纪念中国 1989 年天安门镇压事件的守夜活动。 三人于 8 月因与现已解散的香港联盟的活动而被判“煽动颠覆”罪，该联盟被罚款 150 万港元（191,304 美元，164,768 欧元）。该联盟在维多利亚公园组织了一年一度的天安门守夜活动。 法官援引该组织“结束一党专政”的呼吁，称其挑战了共产党在中国特别行政区统治的合法性。 李和周否认了根据香港有争议的国家安全法提出的颠覆罪指控。被告还坚称联盟没有要求人们做任何非法的事情。 鉴于香港的言论自由自去年镇压大规模民主抗议活动后北京于 2020 年实施该法律以来，香港的言论自由受到严重限制，法院驳回了被告认为自己在法律范围内行事的论点。 守夜活动曾经是香港的一项重大年度活动，但实际上已被法律禁止。 周女士是一名代表自己的大律师，她在被护送出去时举起双臂向支持者挥手致意。 她的母亲周美娜对她的支持者说：“对于今天的判决，你们不必过度悲伤。不要灰心。最重要的是，不要感到内疚。” 这些定罪引起了外国政府和人权组织的批评。 国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“这一判决是一场三重悲剧：活动人士受到不公正的惩罚；天安门镇压本身的幸存者和受害者；几代香港人被剥夺了讨论中国现代历史上最重要事件之一的空间。” 德国和法国上个月谴责了对周的判决，称“和平倡导人权并不构成犯罪”。 根据国安法被捕的人包括民主派前媒体大亨黎智英和前学生领袖黄之锋。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The sentencing of these activists underscores a deep yearning for remembrance and justice, a cry for accountability that echoes through the years. The pursuit of truth, even when met with severe penalties, reflects a profound human need to acknowledge past wrongs and seek a more just future.
reflection.zh: 对这些活动人士的判决，凸显了对纪念和伸张正义的深切渴望，这是多年来挥之不去的对问责的呼唤。追求真相，即使面临严厉的惩罚，也反映了人类承认过去的错误并寻求更公正未来的深刻需求。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...

reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

summary.en: Australians are facing persistently high fuel prices, with regular unleaded expected to remain around $2.11 per liter, due to escalating conflict in the Middle East. Attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have driven global oil prices above $100 per barrel, leading to significant price hikes at the pump in...
summary.zh: 由于中东冲突升级，澳大利亚人正面临持续的高油价，普通无铅汽油预计将维持在每升2.11美元左右。霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭事件已将全球油价推高至每桶100美元以上，导致澳大利亚加油站价格大幅上涨，并引发了对通货膨胀加剧以及澳大利亚储备银行可能加息的担忧。

body.en:
Australians are being warned that high fuel prices are likely to stay as the war in the Middle East reaches dangerous new levels of escalation.

As the US-led war on Iran shows no signs of ending and oil tankers are being targeted and sunk in the Strait of Hormuz by both sides, global oil prices have surged above US $100 ($139.5) a barrel.

This has led to fuel prices in Australia jumping at the bowser to an average price for regular unleaded of $2.11, a massive increase from $1.55 in July.

The surging prices are sparking inflation fears and raising concerns that the Reserve Bank of Australia will lift the cash rate when the monetary policy board meets again at the end of September .

"It really depends exclusively, almost, on what's going to happen in the Middle East," he said.

"We've seen dangerous levels of escalation in the last few days, so you've got the situation where they're blowing up each other's oil tankers in the ocean, so that doesn't help."

In response to soaring prices at the start of the conflict in the Middle East in March, the Albanese government temporarily halved the fuel excise in April, slashing 26 cents off a litre.

A scaled-back extension of the fuel excise was reduced to 16 cents per litre for petrol and diesel, which lasted until 2 August.

Khoury said the government keeping its options open remained the best approach to the unfolding crisis.

"Even though the average price for unleaded nationally is $2.11, in April it was $2.60, and that was at that point when the government cut the excise," he said.

"It is obviously expensive, more expensive than we want it to be, but it's nowhere near those levels."

Khoury urged motorists to check fuel prices in real-time and shop around for savings when filling up.

About one fifth of the world's oil transits through the Strait of Hormuz, with fighting between the two countries centring on control for the key shipping route.

title.en: As China rises, Australia is increasingly enmeshed in the US war machine. Is the alliance still worth the risk?
title.zh: 随着中国崛起，澳大利亚日益卷入美国战争机器。联盟是否仍值得冒险？

summary.en: Experts warn that Australia is being exploited by an ally that could draw it, however unwillingly, into war with China. Kevin Rudd, speaking at the National Press Club, emphasized the importance of physical security and the US alliance as a 'force multiplier' for Australia's defense needs, while also acknowledging the...
summary.zh: 专家警告说，澳大利亚正被一个盟友所利用，该盟友可能不情愿地将澳大利亚卷入与中国的战争。凯文·拉德在国家新闻俱乐部发表讲话时，强调了国家安全的重要性以及与美国的联盟是澳大利亚国防需求的“力量倍增器”，同时也承认了其中的风险。

body.en:
“Physical security matters,” said Kevin Rudd , at his axiomatic best before the National Press Club this week.

“Our first responsibility is to secure our people’s future in this most contested region of the world.”

Prime minister, to foreign minister, to ambassador, Rudd – on his self-declared, self-deprecatory “career trajectory towards infinitesimal demotion” – has an unparalleled perspective on Australia’s place in the world.

In a time of dramatic global upheaval, he argued, the nation’s security alliance with the United States was neither trivial nor sentimental.

“Our alliance with the United States remains a force multiplier for Australia’s defence needs.”

But, Rudd said, it did represent one of the seismic challenges Australia faced: countenancing “the rise and rise of China at a time when America continues to debate what sort of global power it wants to be in the future”.

Alliance with the US, he said, was necessary but not sufficient for the country’s long-term national security.

“We must also re-embrace national self-reliance to anticipate the full range of future uncertainties.” A Rudd sentence if ever one was said.

Twice in a row, Rudd was asked whether Australia would even have a choice if the US were to become involved in a war with China over Taiwan, which Rudd judged a “one in three” chance in 2028 (the year of Taiwan’s next presidential election).

Or whether, in that scenario, Australian support would be automatically expected.

Both times Rudd declined to answer, even as he was asked directly whether – if US nuclear submarines were steaming from Australian ports, and US bombers taking off from Australian airfields, heading for Chinese sea and airspace – Australia could decline to be part of another American war.

This week, the Guardian published new data showing the US military and its defence industrial interests control, or have access to, more than 100 military bases across the Australian continent.

The enmeshment of the Australian military within the giant US war machine has hastened over recent years, and is set to grow even further.

US nuclear-capable bombers take off from Australian airfields on missions across the world – potentially carrying nuclear weapons (the US government won’t say, Australia won’t ask). From next year, nuclear-powered, conventionally armed submarines will port through HMAS Stirling off Perth.

The US remains Australia’s fundamental security ally, but it is also a country currently mired in what many international law experts say is an illegal, unprompted war , and one seen by many in Australia as a superpower in decline and increasingly unreliable.

The federal government maintains the US remains indispensable to Australian security. Marking 75 years of the Anzus Treaty this week, the...
body.zh: “人身安全很重要，”陆克文本周在国家新闻俱乐部上以他最不言而喻的方式说道。 “我们的首要责任是在世界上这个竞争最激烈的地区确保我们人民的未来。” 从总理、外交部长到大使，陆克文——关于他自我宣称、自嘲的“走向无限降级的职业轨迹”——对澳大利亚在世界上的地位有着无与伦比的视角。 他认为，在全球发生剧烈动荡的时期，美国与美国的安全联盟既不是微不足道的，也不是感伤的。 “我们与美国的联盟仍然是澳大利亚国防需求的力量倍增器。” 但是，陆克文表示，这确实代表了澳大利亚面临的巨大挑战之一：“在美国继续争论未来想要成为什么样的全球强国之际，支持中国的崛起和崛起”。 他说，与美国结盟是必要的，但对于该国的长期国家安全来说还不够。 “我们还必须重新拥抱国家自力更生，以应对未来的各种不确定性。”如果有人说过的话，那就是陆克文的一句话。 陆克文连续两次被问到，如果美国因台湾问题卷入与中国的战争，澳大利亚是否还有选择，陆克文认为 2028 年（台湾下一届总统选举的年份）有“三分之一”的机会。 或者在这种情况下，是否会自动预期澳大利亚的支持。 陆克文两次都拒绝回答，即使他被直接问到——如果美国核潜艇从澳大利亚港口出发，美国轰炸机从澳大利亚机场起飞，前往中国海域和空域——澳大利亚是否会拒绝参与另一场美国战争。 本周，《卫报》发布的新数据显示，美国军方及其国防工业利益集团控制或有权使用澳大利亚大陆 100 多个军事基地。 近年来，澳大利亚军队与美国庞大战争机器的纠缠不断加速，而且还将进一步加剧。 美国可携带核弹头的轰炸机从澳大利亚机场起飞，执行世界各地的任务——可能携带核武器（美国政府不会说，澳大利亚也不会问）。从明年开始，核动力常规武装潜艇将通过珀斯附近的斯特林号舰艇停靠。 美国仍然是澳大利亚的基本安全盟友，但它也是一个目前深陷许多国际法专家所说的非法、自发战争的国家，并且被澳大利亚许多人视为正在衰落且越来越不可靠的超级大国。 联邦政府坚称美国对澳大利亚的安全仍然不可或缺。本周纪念《安苏斯条约》75 周年，...

reflection.en: The complex geopolitical landscape, as described by Kevin Rudd, demands careful consideration of alliances. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that 'where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety.' Australia's strategic decisions, particularly concerning its alliance with the US and potential conflict with China,...
reflection.zh: 正如凯文·拉德所描述的复杂地缘政治格局，需要仔细权衡联盟关系。《箴言》11章14节提醒我们：“没有谋士，国就败落；谋士多，国就安。”澳大利亚的战略决策，尤其是在与美国的联盟以及与中国的潜在冲突方面，需要众多声音的智慧来安全地导航。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.zh: 可能让澳大利亚陷入困境的数字，如果我们处理不当

summary.en: Australians want immigration changes to improve the country, but they need to be done the right way. After the COVID-19 pandemic, the number of migrants flowing into Australia increased to "unbelievable levels," says immigration expert Abul Rizvi. Numbers had fallen sharply during the pandemic years as lockdown...

body.en:
Share your feedback and help us improve this feature. Read more about how we use AI at SBS here.

After the COVID-19 pandemic, the number of migrants flowing into Australia increased to "unbelievable levels", says immigration expert Abul Rizvi.

Numbers had fallen sharply during the pandemic years as lockdown measures halted international travel. By March 2021, quarterly migrant arrivals had dropped to a fifth of pre-pandemic levels in Australia.

Rizvi, a former deputy secretary at the Department of Immigration, says no one was expecting net overseas migration (NOM) — which also factors in migrant departures — to reach a record annual high of almost 550,000 people as it did in 2023.

Almost three years later, Australia is still adjusting to that influx, and politicians across the ideological divide are now fixated on setting a new figure.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The recent debate over Australia's NOM has been dominated by One Nation, which is calling for substantial cuts to immigration.

But research shows that opposition to immigration is often concentrated in areas with the fewest migrants.

Experts say these areas could also be among the worst hit by wide-ranging cuts, such as those proposed by One Nation.

Temporary migrants have historically been a driver of population growth in Australia. Typically, more migrants arrive each year than those who leave, increasing the overall population over time.

One Nation leader Pauline Hanson has accused Labor of using migration to prop up headline economic numbers, saying in a media release: "Australians pay the price through lower wages, higher rents, unaffordable homes and stretched services."

To address these issues, Hanson says the number of migrants should be reduced, insisting that "international student numbers must be slashed". She has also called for the skilled migration program to be more targeted, and immigration from countries on the 'Do Not Travel' list to be halted.

The latest Department of Home Affairs figures show 2.9 million temporary visa holders were living in Australia on 31 July 2026.

The largest single group was New Zealanders holding 'special category visas', which accounted for 20 per cent (736,509) of temporary visa holders.

Temporary visa holders, who also include tourists or those undertaking short-term work or study, are not considered migrants by the ABS unless they are in the country for longer than a year.

Global migration expert and associate professor at the University of Sydney, Anna Boucher, says some temporary visa holders are still in Australia due to decisions made by former governments, including extensions granted after the pandemic...

title.en: Could Australia's housing downturn push the economy into recession?
title.zh: 澳大利亚房价下跌是否会将经济推入衰退？

summary.en: Falling house prices could slow spending and growth, but economists say a housing-led recession is far from certain.
summary.zh: 房价下跌可能会减缓支出和增长，但经济学家表示，由住房市场引发的衰退远非必然。

body.en:
Australians have watched the value of their homes soar for years. Now, as prices head in the opposite direction, there are warnings the fallout could spread well beyond the property market.

Property developer Nigel Satterley has warned Australia could face a "full-blown recession" if the housing downturn spills into consumer spending, as falling property values leave households feeling poorer and less willing to spend.

The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) has pushed back on those fears, acknowledging the downturn will slow parts of the economy but saying it does not currently expect a recession.

Independent economist Saul Eslake agrees with the RBA that the housing downturn is likely to slow economic growth, but says falling property prices alone are unlikely to be enough to push Australia into recession.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I don't think a decline in property prices of the orders of magnitude that people are now talking about ... that is to say, maybe of the order of 10, perhaps in some cities 15 per cent over a one or two-year period, I don't think that on its own would precipitate a recession," he said.

"It would certainly contribute at the margin to some slowing in economic growth."

AMP Chief Economist Shane Oliver also believes a recession is not the most likely outcome, but sees a greater risk that the housing downturn could contribute to one if prices continue falling and the broader economy weakens.

"Recession isn't my base case, but the risk is significant," he said, putting the probability at around 30 per cent and rising.

Put simply, when the value of an asset such as a home rises, people can feel wealthier and become more comfortable spending. When its value falls, the opposite can happen.

Oliver said previous RBA analysis suggested a 10 per cent fall in house prices could reduce consumer spending by about 0.8 per cent after six months and 1.6 per cent over the longer term.

That matters because household consumption makes up a significant portion of economic activity.

"If the economy is weak enough to start with because of higher interest rates and other things, then that could potentially knock us into recession because the consumer is about 60 per cent of the economy," Oliver said.

But Eslake said the relationship between property values and spending was not necessarily straightforward.

For most Australians who own only the home they live in, he said its value was largely "paper wealth" unless they sold.

If someone is selling to buy another property, falling prices also mean the home they are moving into is likely to be cheaper.

body.zh: 多年来，澳大利亚人见证了自己房屋价值的飙升。现在，随着价格朝着相反的方向发展，有人警告称，其影响可能会远远超出房地产市场。 房地产开发商奈杰尔·萨特利(Nigel Satterley)警告称，如果房地产市场低迷蔓延到消费者支出，澳大利亚可能面临“全面衰退”，因为房价下跌会让家庭感觉更穷，更不愿意花钱。 澳大利亚储备银行（RBA）反驳了这些担忧，承认经济低迷将放缓部分经济，但表示目前预计不会出现衰退。 独立经济学家索尔·埃斯莱克（Saul Eslake）同意澳大利亚央行的观点，即房地产市场低迷可能会减缓经济增长，但他表示，仅房地产价格下跌不太可能足以将澳大利亚推入衰退。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他表示：“我认为房地产价格的下降幅度不会像人们现在谈论的那样......也就是说，在一两年内可能下降 10％，在某些城市可能下降 15％，我认为这本身不会引发经济衰退。” “这肯定会在一定程度上导致经济增长放缓。” AMP 首席经济学家肖恩·奥利弗 (Shane Oliver) 也认为，经济衰退并不是最有可能的结果，但他认为，如果价格继续下跌且整体经济疲软，房地产市场低迷可能会导致经济衰退的风险更大。 “经济衰退不是我的基本情况，但风险很大，”他说，他认为这种可能性在 30% 左右，而且还在上升。 简而言之，当房屋等资产的价值上升时，人们会感觉更富有，消费也更放心。当其价值下降时，可能会发生相反的情况。 奥利弗表示，此前澳洲联储的分析表明，房价下跌10%可能会在六个月后减少消费者支出约0.8%，从长远来看会减少1.6%。 这很重要，因为家庭消费占经济活动的很大一部分。 奥利弗表示：“如果由于利率上升和其他因素导致经济一开始就足够疲软，那么我们可能会陷入衰退，因为消费者约占经济的 60%。” 但埃斯莱克表示，房地产价值和支出之间的关系并不一定是直接的。 他表示，对于大多数只拥有自己居住的房屋的澳大利亚人来说，除非他们出售，否则房屋的价值主要是“纸面财富”。 如果有人出售房产以购买另一处房产，价格下跌也意味着他们搬入的房屋可能会更便宜。 本周早些时候，澳大利亚央行助理行长萨拉·亨特还表示……

reflection.en: As property values decline in Australia, households may feel less wealthy, leading to reduced spending. This economic principle echoes the ancient wisdom of Proverbs 22:7, which warns that 'the borrower is slave to the lender.' When asset values fall, the perceived wealth and financial security of homeowners can diminish, impacting their willingness to...
reflection.zh: 随着澳大利亚房价下跌，家庭可能会感到财富缩水，从而减少支出。这一经济现象呼应了古老的智慧，《箴言》22:7 警告说：“欠债的是债主的仆人。”当资产价值下降时，房主的财富和财务安全感可能会减弱，影响他们的消费和投资意愿。

verse.textEn: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is slave to the lender.
verse.textZh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。

Staying with One Nation: what does the coverage of Warren Pickering’s press conference this week say about how the media – and the public – treats political leaders differently? And the prime minister continues to come under scrutiny over grants awarded to a golf club in his electorate Hastie accepts apology from Joyce over ‘traitor’ cartoon as Hanson doubles down and tells critics to ‘chill’ Email the show: backtobackbarries@theguardian.com Continue reading...
body.zh: 巴里·卡西迪（Barrie Cassidy）和肖恩·凯利（Sean Kelly）（本周接替托尼·巴里）直接前往自由党前座议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂（Andrew Hastie）与宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）一起观看动画片。哈斯蒂是少数愿意与一国党领导人较量的政客之一吗？这是否会成为自由党反击的开始？与一国保持一致：沃伦·皮克林本周新闻发布会的报道对媒体和公众如何以不同方式对待政治领导人有什么看法？总理继续因向其选区的一家高尔夫俱乐部提供资助而受到审查。哈斯蒂接受乔​​伊斯就“叛徒”漫画所做的道歉，而汉森则加倍努力，告诉批评者“冷静”。

reflection.en: In the heat of political disagreement, the temptation is to mirror harshness with harshness. Andrew Hastie's decision to accept an apology, even amidst ongoing conflict, offers a moment of grace. Proverbs 15:1 reminds us that a gentle answer can de-escalate tension, while harsh words inflame it.
reflection.zh: 在政治分歧的激烈争论中，人们很容易以强硬回应强硬。安德鲁·哈斯蒂选择接受道歉，即使在持续的冲突中，也提供了一个恩典的时刻。《箴言》15:1 提醒我们，温和的回答可以缓和紧张局势，而伤人的话语只会激化矛盾。

verse.textEn: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verse.textZh: 回答柔和，使怒消退；言语暴戾，触动怒气。

summary.en: An inquiry has heard that passengers in the bush are paying significantly more per kilometre than even those flying to or from regional cities. Bush communities are begging for more budget airfares even as regional airline Rex warns that stiff competition in small markets is pushing the airline to the brink. Isolated...
summary.zh: 一项调查了解到，偏远地区（bush）的乘客每公里支付的费用远高于往返区域性城市的乘客。偏远地区的社区迫切希望获得更便宜的机票，与此同时，区域航空公司Rex警告称，小型市场的激烈竞争正将该航空公司推向破产边缘。新南威尔士州中海岸地区发展局的首席执行官Madeleine...

body.en:
Bush communities are begging for more budget airfares even as regional airline Rex warns that stiff competition in small markets is pushing the airline to the brink.

Isolated and aging populations are being let down by expensive ticket costs, Madeleine Lawler, chief executive of Regional Development Australia on the Mid North Coast of NSW, warned.

Her comments came during the latest public hearing into the state of Australia's regional aviation sector.

Flights from Coffs Harbour or Port Macquarie cost about 71 cents per kilometre, but from Ballina, where budget flights are available on Jetstar, the average is 12 cents per kilometre, Lawler told the inquiry.

"When I first moved to Coffs Harbour, I was able to get a Bonza flight for under 100 bucks, or Tiger Air was in there for a while, and I was able to get around in a really affordable way," she said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"We are slicing demand out of our economies by not having those lower price points available in the market, and that means our tourism economies suffer as well."

But half-empty planes could not cover the costs required to run a flight, so Rex shared the burden with travellers from the bush or cancelled services, the struggling airline's network strategy general manager Warrick Lodge told the hearing.

"You end up in a situation where ... carriers are forced to charge each of those passengers more to try and cover their costs," he said.

In July 2024, Rex entered voluntary administration only to be kept afloat with a taxpayer-funded package of $40 million before being bought by American company Air T in December 2025.

Rex had already provided 40,000 seats a year to a market that only had 22,000 passengers — then Qantas added another 31,000.

Now, no airline flies Melbourne to Albury, while Rex pulled all services to Devonport in June.

Across the business, some Rex routes barely covered operating costs, while others were forced to contribute to overheads, Lodge said.

The airline has deals in place with the Queensland and WA governments, which subsidise operations in those states.

The Royal Flying Doctor Service told the hearing that regional airlines are critical to their operations.

Adequate air travel supported early intervention and helped patients avoid emergency treatment.

"Many of these flights will be to retrieve Australians who are critically ill and need urgent medical evacuation," federation chief executive Emma Buchanan said.

body.zh: 尽管区域航空公司雷克斯警告说，小市场的激烈竞争正在将航空公司推向崩溃的边缘，但布什社区仍在乞求更多的廉价机票。 新南威尔士州中北海岸澳大利亚区域发展公司首席执行官玛德琳·劳勒警告说，昂贵的门票价格正在让偏僻和老龄化的人口感到失望。 她是在最近一次有关澳大利亚支线航空业状况的公开听证会上发表上述言论的。 劳勒告诉调查组，从考夫斯港或麦觉理港出发的航班每公里票价约为 71 美分，但从巴利纳出发（捷星航空提供廉价航班）的平均票价为每公里 12 美分。 “当我第一次搬到科夫斯港时，我能以不到 100 美元的价格买到 Bonza 航班，或者虎航在那里呆了一段时间，我能够以非常实惠的方式出行，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “由于市场上没有较低的价格点，我们正在削减经济中的需求，这意味着我们的旅游经济也会受到影响。” 但陷入困境的航空公司网络战略总经理沃里克·洛奇(Warrick Lodge)在听证会上表示，半空的飞机无法支付运行航班所需的费用，因此雷克斯与来自丛林的旅客分担负担或取消航班。 他说：“最终的结果是……航空公司被迫向每位乘客收取更多费用，以试图弥补他们​​的费用。” 2024 年 7 月，Rex 进入自愿托管，但在 2025 年 12 月被美国公司 Air T 收购之前，仅靠纳税人资助的 4000 万美元的资金维持生存。 Rex 每年向只有 22,000 名乘客的市场提供 40,000 个座位，然后澳洲航空又增加了 31,000 个座位。 现在，没有航空公司有从墨尔本飞往奥尔伯里的航班，而雷克斯在六月取消了所有飞往德文波特的航班。 洛奇说，在整个业务中，一些雷克斯航线几乎无法支付运营成本，而其他航线则被迫承担管理费用。 该航空公司与昆士兰州和西澳州政府签订了协议，为这些州的运营提供补贴。 皇家飞行医生服务中心在听证会上表示，支线航空公司对其运营至关重要。 充足的航空旅行支持早期干预并帮助患者避免紧急治疗。 联合会首席执行官艾玛·布坎南（Emma Buchanan）表示：“其中许多航班将接回病情危重且需要紧急医疗后送的澳大利亚人。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The inquiry into regional airfares reveals a struggle for accessibility, particularly impacting isolated and aging populations. These communities, often overlooked, are paying disproportionately high costs for essential travel. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute." This...
reflection.zh: 关于偏远地区机票价格的调查揭示了出行便利性的困境，尤其影响了孤立和老龄化的人群。这些社区常常被忽视，却要为必要的出行支付不成比例的高昂费用。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们：“为不能说话的，就是一切被压住的，伸明伸冤。” 这段经文提醒我们要为那些声音不易被听见的人发声，确保他们的需求得到关注。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: A 16-hour flight, 100,000 fans and an upset: The NFL makes its Australian debut
title.zh: 一场16小时的飞行，10万粉丝和一场意外：NFL首次亮相澳大利亚

summary.en: For some Americans, the long trek to see their teams clash on the other side of the world was well worth the journey.
summary.zh: 对于一些美国人来说，长途跋涉到世界的另一边观看他们支持的球队比赛是值得的。

body.en:
More than 100,000 fans from across Australia and abroad flooded the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) on Friday to watch the San Francisco 49ers thrash the Los Angeles Rams 27-7 in the NFL's first-ever regular-season game in Australia.

With the match kicking off at 10am to line up with US prime time, one Rams fan at the MCG described it as the earliest he'd ever been up for a game.

"The atmosphere, I love it, but it's kind of quiet," he told SBS News. "You know, back home it would usually be a bit crazier, with both teams going at it."

Another fan was adding Melbourne to a list of 43 overseas stadiums he'd visited. His white jersey was embroidered with patches representing each country, with a small green patch featuring a cluster of koalas to represent Melbourne on the bottom left.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I've been to every stadium in the world where the NFL plays," he told SBS News. "It's my first time in Australia, and I love it, everyone is so nice and inviting and helpful."

"I flew all the way in from Miami, Florida, two days ago, and I'm going home tonight. I just came to witness this amazing stadium and the great people of Melbourne."

Friday's game was the first of a four-year deal between Australia and the NFL , but with no guarantee a game will be played here every year, thousands of overseas fans made the pilgrimage.

A sea of red, white, blue and yellow filled the MCG, with a sold-out crowd of 100,022 fans, including thousands of visitors from the US. Almost half of spectators were expected to be from interstate or overseas, according to the state government.

Los Angeles resident Nancy Gakere took advantage of the opportunity for a holiday, stopping over in Fiji on the way to and from Melbourne to break up what could have been a 16-hour direct flight.

She said the journey was more than worth it, especially as the 49ers, pegged as the underdogs, pulled off a surprise rout.

"Everything was just great; honestly, we couldn't have planned it any better," she told SBS News.

"When this away game happened to be in Australia, we thought, why not? And we booked the trip as soon as tickets came out in April, so we have been excited about it for a while."

"And being 49ers fans, we were not the favourites, so we came in with low expectations, and winning was a nice surprise."

Gakere said that staying in Brunswick, in Melbourne's north, had made the trip economical.

"Other than the Uber from the airport, we have just been taking the tram in and out of the city to sight-see, trying food, the bars, walking around and exploring," she told SBS News. "And we went to the Great Ocean Road, which was our main tourism activity."

body.zh: 周五，来自澳大利亚各地和国外的超过 100,000 名球迷涌入墨尔本板球场 (MCG)，观看旧金山 49 人队以 27-7 击败洛杉矶公羊队，这是 NFL 在澳大利亚的首场常规赛比赛。 比赛于上午 10 点开始，与美国黄金时间一致，MCG 的一位公羊队球迷称这是他参加比赛最早的一场比赛。 “我喜欢这里的气氛，但有点安静，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “你知道，回到主场通常会有点疯狂，两支球队都在努力。” 另一位球迷将墨尔本添加到了他参观过的 43 个海外体育场的名单中。他的白色球衣上绣有代表各个国家的补丁，左下角有一小块绿色补丁，上面有一群考拉，代表墨尔本。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我去过世界上 NFL 比赛的每一个体育场，”他告诉 SBS 新闻。 “这是我第一次来澳大利亚，我很喜欢这里，每个人都那么友善、热情、乐于助人。” “两天前我从佛罗里达州迈阿密一路飞来，今晚我就要回家了。我只是来见证这个令人惊叹的体育场和墨尔本伟大的人民。” 周五的比赛是澳大利亚与 NFL 之间四年协议中的第一场，但由于不能保证每年都会在这里举行比赛，因此成千上万的海外球迷前来朝圣。 MCG 充满了红、白、蓝、黄的海洋，100,022 名粉丝的门票全部售罄，其中包括数千名来自美国的游客。据州政府称，预计近一半观众来自州际或海外。 洛杉矶居民南希·加凯尔(Nancy Gakere)利用假期的机会，在往返墨尔本的途中经停斐济，中断了原本16小时的直飞航班。 她表示这段旅程非常值得，特别是当 49 人队被视为失败者时，却意外地惨败。 “一切都很棒；说实话，我们计划得再好不过了，”她告诉 SBS 新闻。 “当这场客场比赛恰好在澳大利亚举行时，我们想，为什么不呢？而且我们在四月份门票一出来就预订了行程，所以我们兴奋了一段时间。” “作为 49 人队的球迷，我们并不是最受欢迎的球队，所以我们的期望很低，但获胜是一个很大的惊喜。” 加凯雷说，住在墨尔本北部的布伦瑞克让这次旅行很经济。 她告诉 SBS 新闻：“除了机场的 Uber 之外，我们只是乘坐电车进出城市观光、尝试美食、酒吧、四处走走和探索。” “我们去了大洋路，这是我们的主要旅游活动。” SBS新闻...

reflection.en: The NFL's debut in Melbourne drew over 100,000 fans, many undertaking significant journeys to witness the event. This dedication to a sporting spectacle, with its intense training and striving for victory, echoes the Apostle Paul's analogy of athletes competing for a perishable crown. While the earthly prize fades, the discipline and commitment can reflect...
reflection.zh: NFL首次在墨尔本亮相吸引了超过10万名粉丝，许多人为此进行了长途跋涉。这种对体育盛事的奉献精神，以及其中包含的艰苦训练和对胜利的追求，呼应了使徒保罗将运动员为易朽的冠冕而奋斗的比喻。虽然地上的奖赏会消逝，但其中的纪律和投入可以折射出更深层次的追求。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: No medal pressure for SAR athletes: Law
title.zh: 港队亚运奖牌无压力：劳工处长

summary.en: The Minister for Sport, Rosanna Law, stated that she will not set a public medal target for the Hong Kong, China delegation for the upcoming Asian Games. She emphasized that athletes already face significant pressure and that her priority is for them to perform at their best and give their all, rather than focusing on...
summary.zh: 劳工及福利局局长罗致光表示，不会为香港代表团参加下周举行的亚运会设定公开奖牌目标。他强调运动员本身已承受巨大压力，他更关注的是运动员能发挥最佳水平，全力以赴，而不是奖牌预测。

body.en: The minister for sport Rosanna Law said she will not set a public medal target for the Hong Kong, China delegation for next week's Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, stressing that athletes already carry enough pressure. In an exclusive interview, Law told RTHK she deliberately avoids discussing medal predictions ahead of any major competition, preferring to let athletes concentrate on their performance. "It's not that I don't have a figure in mind – of course I do – but what matters most for athletes is that they perform at their own level – ideally even above their usual standard – that they give their all and never give up," she said. "We always say this is the SAR spirit we see in athletes from the Hong Kong, China team. That's what I look forward to." To back up the SAR squad with tangible action, the government has boosted its financial commitment for this year’s Asian Games. While the sports development fund historically covered around 90 percent of travel and participation costs for major international events, the city is now providing full funding for its 580-strong delegation. Law said the move would give athletes more opportunities to sharpen their skills through competition. "However hard you train in the Sports Institute, perhaps an opportunity to go abroad and compete with top tier athletes in the area would be even more effective," she said. "That's why we raised the ceiling for subsidy and we increased the frequency that they could participate in international events and that means an elevation of their resources as well." The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism also pointed to a string of encouraging results from SAR athletes in the lead-up to the Games, including a silver medal for the men’s foil fencing team at the World Championships in Hong Kong. They also include a win and a runner-up finish in men’s badminton singles at the China Masters, and a gold medal for the men’s rugby sevens team at the Asian Rugby Sevens in Suzhou. Law highlighted strong performances in other disciplines as well, such as golf and swimming, and expressed confidence that athletes returning to the Asian Games – especially those who have recently achieved world-class results – would carry a certain degree of self-belief. Turning to team sports, Law said that a comprehensive review of support in this area would be conducted early next year, after the Asian Games. The review, she said, will examine several key areas, including development pathways, medical and sports science support, facility allocation, and coaching quality. Law cited the handball team’s historic semi-final run at the National Games as evidence that amateur teams are capable of delivering memorable performances, even without securing a medal. Currently, eight team sports receive government...
body.zh: 体育部长罗姗娜·罗表示，她不会为下周在爱知名古屋举行的亚运会的中国香港代表团设定公开奖牌目标，并强调运动员已经承受了足够的压力。罗在接受香港电台独家采访时表示，她在任何重大比赛前都刻意避免讨论奖牌预测，而是让运动员专注于自己的表现。 “这并不是说我心里没有一个数字——当然我有——但对运动员来说最重要的是他们在自己的水平上表现——最好甚至高于他们通常的标准——他们全力以赴，永不放弃，”她说。 “我们总是说，这就是我们在中国香港队运动员身上看到的特区精神。这就是我所期待的。”为了以实际行动支持特区队伍，政府加大了对今年亚运会的财政承诺。虽然体育发展基金历来承担重大国际赛事约 90% 的旅行和参与费用，但该市现在为其 580 人的代表团提供全额资金。劳表示，此举将为运动员提供更多机会通过比赛提高技能。 “无论你在体育学院训练多么努力，也许有机会出国与该地区的顶级运动员竞争会更有效，”她说。 “这就是为什么我们提高了补贴上限，并增加了他们参加国际活动的频率，这也意味着他们的资源得到了提升。”文化体育及旅游局局长还指出，特区运动员在奥运会筹备期间取得了一系列令人鼓舞的成绩，其中包括男子花剑击剑队在香港世锦赛上获得银牌。他们还包括在中国大师赛上获得男子羽毛球单打冠军和亚军，以及在苏州举行的亚洲七人制橄榄球赛上获得男子七人制橄榄球团体金牌。罗还强调了高尔夫和游泳等其他项目的强劲表现，并表示相信重返亚运会的运动员，尤其是那些最近取得世界级成绩的运动员，将具有一定程度的自信。谈到团队运动，罗表示，将于明年初亚运会后对这方面的支持进行全面审查。她说，审查将审查几个关键领域，包括发展途径、医疗和运动科学支持、设施分配和教练质量。罗引用手球队在全运会历史性半决赛的表现来证明，即使没有获得奖牌，业余球队也有能力打出令人难忘的表现。目前，八项团体运动项目受到政府...

reflection.en: Minister Rosanna Law wisely shields Hong Kong athletes from the pressure of public medal targets, encouraging them instead to focus on their personal best and the spirit of never giving up. This approach aligns with the biblical call to do all work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, finding dignity and purpose in dedicated effort itself, regardless of...
reflection.zh: 香港体育专员罗致光明智地让运动员免受公众奖牌目标的压力，鼓励他们专注于个人最佳表现和永不放弃的精神。这种做法与圣经中“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的”的呼吁一致，在付出的努力本身中找到尊严和意义，而非仅仅关注结果。...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: 'Kai Tak Sports Park targets need pragmatic revamp'
title.zh: 启德体育园目标需要务实检讨

summary.en: Hong Kong's Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, stated that the performance targets for the Kai Tak Sports Park, which is one and a half years old, require a pragmatic overhaul, despite its status as a top Asian venue. She noted that the park has significantly boosted Hong Kong's economy by hosting...
summary.zh: 文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄表示，启用一年半的启德体育园“数十年前”制定的表现目标需要务实检讨，尽管该体育园是亚洲顶级的场地。她指出，启德体育园通过举办大型体育赛事，已成为香港经济的“游戏规则改变者”，推动了经济增长。她以去年举办的全运会为例，证明香港有能力举办一系列高水平的各项体育赛事。

body.en: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law has said the one-and-a-half year old Kai Tak Sports Park's "decades-old" performance targets need a pragmatic overhaul, even though it is a top venue in Asia. Law told RTHK in an exclusive interview that Kai Tak Sports Park has been a game changer for Hong Kong's economy, driving growth through major sporting events. "The hosting of the National Games last year proves the point that Hong Kong is very capable of hosting a series of high-level competitions in different areas of sports," she said. "Thereafter, we actually focus our energy on hosting high-level major international events in single areas, such as badminton, volleyball, table tennis and fencing not to mention rugby sevens." But Law said the current performance indicators, which measure the venue's success by the number of "event days", were set years ago and fail to account for practical realities. "Even a football match isn't just about that one day. When preparing – laying turf and maintaining turf quality – the better the pitch quality, the more time you need for maintenance," she said. "These are things we need to consider when hosting sports events – we need to allocate that time. So in terms of meeting targets, we need to be pragmatic and up-to-date." But Law insisted the park has already delivered significant economic benefits. The summer Hong Kong Football Festival generated strong ticket sales and merchandise revenue, while pop-up stores and catering outlets at the park performed well. She also noted that international events have drawn tourists who stayed for multiple days, boosting hotels and dining across the city. Looking ahead, Law said Hong Kong will prioritise top-tier single-sport World Championships over bidding for the Olympics in the short-to-medium term. "Hosting the Olympics would certainly be a national act, a national decision," she said. "Given our current resource considerations and our short-to-medium-term sports development targets, focusing on top-level single-sport events and doing them well is a more important policy goal for us." Beyond sports, Law said the sports park has transformed Hong Kong's ability to attract global superstar concerts. "In the past, many friends might have said we were at a disadvantage in attracting superstar acts. But since Kai Tak Sports Park opened, we've seen that superstar acts are really interested in Hong Kong – many have already succeeded, and more will come," she said. Ultimately, Law said there is always room for improvement for the sports park. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜表示，虽然启德体育公园是亚洲顶级场地，但已有一年半历史的启德体育公园“数十年历史”的绩效目标需要务实的改革。罗先生在接受香港电台独家专访时表示，启德体育园已改变香港经济的游戏规则，通过大型体育赛事推动经济增长。她说：“去年举办全运会证明香港有能力举办一系列不同体育领域的高水平比赛。” “此后，我们实际上把精力集中在举办单一领域的高水平重大国际赛事上，比如羽毛球、排球、乒乓球、击剑，更不用说七人制橄榄球了。”但劳表示，目前的绩效指标是多年前制定的，通过“活动天数”来衡量场馆的成功，未能考虑到实际情况。 “即使是一场足球比赛也不仅仅是有一天的事情。在准备时——铺设草坪和保持草坪质量——场地质量越好，维护所需的时间就越多，”她说。 “这些都是我们在举办体育赛事时需要考虑的事情——我们需要分配时间。因此，在实现目标方面，我们需要务实并与时俱进。”但劳坚称该园区已经带来了显着的经济效益。夏季香港足球节带来强劲的门票销售及商品收入，公园内的快闪店及餐饮店亦表现不俗。她还指出，国际活动吸引了游客停留多日，促进了全市酒店和餐饮业的发展。展望未来，罗先生表示，在中短期内，香港将优先考虑举办顶级单项世界锦标赛，而不是申办奥运会。 “举办奥运会肯定是一项国家行为、一项国家决定，”她说。 “从我们目前的资源考虑和中短期体育发展目标来看，聚焦并办好顶级单项赛事是我们更重要的政策目标。”除了体育之外，罗说，体育公园还改变了香港吸引全球巨星音乐会的能力。她说：“以前，很多朋友可能会说我们在吸引巨星方面处于劣势。但自从启德体育公园开业以来，我们发现巨星对香港确实很感兴趣，很多人已经成功了，而且还会有更多。”最后，劳表示，体育公园总有改进的空间。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The Kai Tak Sports Park, a significant investment for Hong Kong, is undergoing a review of its performance targets. This process underscores the need for careful planning and adaptation in large-scale projects. Committing our endeavors, whether in sports infrastructure or personal pursuits, to divine guidance can lead to more effective and fruitful outcomes.
reflection.zh: 启德体育园是香港的一项重要投资，目前正对其表现目标进行检讨。这一过程凸显了在大型项目中进行审慎规划和适应性调整的必要性。将我们的努力，无论是体育基础设施还是个人追求，都交托给神的指引，可以带来更有效和硕果累累的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Yu Zidi: China’s fearless swimming prodigy, 13, with Olympics in her sights
title.zh: 余梓迪：中国无畏的游泳天才，13岁，奥运在望

summary.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut...
summary.zh: 余梓迪去年12岁时创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛最年轻的奖牌得主。如今已是青少年，她领衔中国队争夺亚运会霸主地位，并以奥运荣耀为目标。这位13岁的留着精灵短发的在校女生……

body.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. China’s swimmer Yu Zidi prepares for the final of the women’s 200m butterfly swimming event during the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore on July 31, 2025. Photo: Oli Scarff/AFP. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut stunned the sporting world last year with a series of eye-popping times. At the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore she helped China reach the 4x200m women’s freestyle relay final. She did not swim in the final but China came third, earning Yu a historic bronze for swimming in the heats. Yu just missed out on medals in the 200m and 400m individual medley events and the 200m butterfly, coming fourth in all three races. In November at China’s National Games, having just turned 13, she clocked a blistering 2:07.41 in the women’s 200m medley for what was then an Asian record. While training with the China team in Beijing, she told local media this month she was “excited” for her Asian Games debut. “Train well, don’t slack off. Demonstrate the level of your training and work hard to break past yourself,” she said, according to state news agency Xinhua. The Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan open on September 19. Pressure ‘like a stone’ A coach, Ha Sinan, once described Yu with a Chinese saying that translates as “a newborn calf fearless of tigers”. But the teenager has spoken of struggling to deal with the heavy load placed on her. Yu grew up in the city of Baoding, about 150 kilometres (90 miles) south of Beijing. She started swimming aged six and since then has juggled schoolwork with training. “Being in class all day and still having to train was really tiring,” she said in January. “Sometimes I was so tired I could fall asleep even while eating,” she said at an event celebrating Hebei province’s National Games wins. Yu said she “never considered quitting” and always dreamed of being a national champion. But during the tune-up to last year’s National Games she said the pressure of wanting to win the 400m medley nearly became too much. “It was like a big stone that weighed on me and made it hard to breathe,” she said. Yu eventually told her coach she wanted to do anything other than train. Her coach told her to persevere and “believe in yourself”, she said. Yu went on to win four medals at the National Games. Some in the swimming world have questioned the mental and physical impact of high-level training and competing on Yu...
body.zh: 去年，12岁的于紫迪创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛上最年轻的奖牌获得者。如今，十几岁的她成为中国争夺亚运会冠军的头条新闻，并瞄准了奥运会的荣耀。 2025 年 7 月 31 日，在新加坡举行的 2025 年世界游泳锦标赛上，中国游泳运动员于子迪正在备战女子 200 米蝶泳决赛。照片：Oli Scarff/法新社。这位留着精灵发型的 13 岁女学生去年以一系列令人瞠目结舌的成绩震惊了体育界。在2025年新加坡世界游泳锦标赛上，她帮助中国队进入了女子4x200米自由泳接力决赛。她没有参加决赛，但中国队获得了第三名，为余在预赛中获得历史性的铜牌。于刚在200米和400米个人混合泳以及200米蝶泳项目中错失奖牌，在所有三场比赛中均获得第四名。 11月的中国全运会上，刚满13岁的她在女子200米混合泳中取得了惊人的2分07.41秒的成绩，创造了当时的亚洲纪录。在北京与中国队一起训练时，她本月对当地媒体表示，她对自己的亚运首秀感到“兴奋”。据官方通讯社新华社报道，她说：“好好训练，不要懈怠。展示你的训练水平，努力突破自己。”日本爱知名古屋亚运会将于9月19日开幕。压力“如石” 教练哈斯南曾用中国的一句话来形容于玉，“初生牛犊不怕虎”。但这位少女表示，她正在努力应对所承受的沉重负担。于在北京以南约 150 公里（90 英里）的保定市长大。她六岁开始游泳，从那时起她就兼顾学业和训练。 “一整天都在课堂上，而且还要训练，真的很累，”她在一月份说道。 “有时我太累了，连吃饭的时候都能睡着，”她在庆祝河北省全运会胜利的活动中说道。于说她“从未考虑过放弃”，一直梦想着成为全国冠军。但在去年全运会的备战期间，她表示想要赢得 4 亿米混合泳冠军的压力几乎变得太大了。 “这就像一块大石头压在我身上，让我呼吸困难，”她说。于最终告诉她的教练，除了训练之外，她想做任何事情。她说，她的教练告诉她要坚持下去并“相信自己”。于随后在全运会上赢得了四枚奖牌。游泳界的一些人质疑高水平训练和比赛对运动员心理和身体的影响……

reflection.en: At just 13, Yu Zidi is already making waves, aiming for the highest levels of competitive swimming. Her journey embodies the dedication and discipline required to pursue athletic excellence, reminding us of the Apostle Paul's exhortation to run with all our might for the prize that is imperishable. May her youthful ambition inspire perseverance in all...
reflection.zh: 年仅13岁的余梓迪已在泳坛掀起波澜，朝着竞技游泳的最高殿堂迈进。她的旅程体现了追求卓越体育成就所需的奉献和纪律，提醒我们使徒保罗的劝勉：要竭力奔跑，去赢得那永不朽坏的冠冕。 愿她年轻的志向激励我们在所有事业中坚持不懈，无论是在体育、学业还是信仰上，尽我们所能，因为我们知道真正的奖赏超越世俗的赞誉。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Man nabbed for theft over Mark Six dispute
title.zh: 男子因六合彩纠纷被捕涉嫌盗窃

summary.en: Police arrested a 36-year-old man on suspicion of theft after he allegedly refused to share lottery winnings with colleagues who had pooled money for a Mark Six ticket, and then disappeared. The winnings were reportedly deposited into his account. The man works for the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, which...
summary.zh: 警方以涉嫌盗窃为由逮捕了一名36岁男子。据称，该男子拒绝与合伙购买六合彩彩票的同事分享彩票奖金，随后失踪。奖金据称已存入其账户。该男子在食物环境卫生署工作，该部门已证实警方正在进行调查。

body.en: Police have arrested a 36-year-old man on suspicion of theft after he allegedly refused to share lottery winnings with colleagues who pooled money for a Mark Six ticket, then disappeared. Media reports say the man placed the bet, and the winnings were deposited into his account. He reportedly works at the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department. The department acknowledged that police have launched an investigation. It said it would cooperate. Police were alerted on Wednesday after the informant and the arrested man couldn’t agree on how to split the prize money, totalling about HK$30 million. Edited by Robert Kemp
body.zh: 警方以涉嫌盗窃罪逮捕了一名 36 岁男子，据称他拒绝与凑钱购买马克六号彩票的同事分享彩票奖金，然后失踪。媒体报道称，该男子下了注，奖金已存入他的账户。据报道，他在食物环境卫生署工作。该部门承认警方已展开调查。并表示将予以合作。因举报人和被捕男子未能就如何分配总计约3,000万港元的奖金达成一致，警方于周三接到报警。罗伯特·坎普编辑

reflection.en: The pursuit of wealth can tragically lead individuals to betray trust and act dishonestly. This man's alleged actions, driven by the temptation of HK$30 million, highlight how the love of money can become a snare, causing immense harm to relationships and integrity. May we guard our hearts against greed, remembering that true wealth lies not in riches, but...
reflection.zh: 对财富的追求可能导致个人背叛信任并采取不诚实的行为。这名男子据称因贪图三千万港元的奖金而采取的行动，凸显了贪财之心如何成为网罗，对人际关系和正直造成巨大伤害。 愿我们保守我们的心，不被贪婪所胜，并铭记真正的财富不在于财富本身，而在于忠信和正直的人际关系。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Tung Chee-hwa had a clear vision for Hong Kong
title.zh: 董建華對香港有清晰的願景

summary.en: The death of Tung Chee-hwa at age 89 has prompted a necessary reckoning with the legacy of Hong Kong’s first chief executive. Two decades after his resignation, the question endures: was Tung a hapless administrator overwhelmed by crisis, or a prescient leader constrained by circumstance and an unforgiving political...
summary.zh: 香港首任行政長官董建華逝世，享年89歲，引發了對其執政遺產的必要反思。他辭職二十年後，問題依然存在：董建華是一位被危機壓垮的無能 प्रशास官，還是一位受制於環境和嚴酷政治氛圍的先見之明領導者？

body.en: The death of Tung Chee-hwa at age 89 has prompted a necessary reckoning with the legacy of Hong Kong’s first chief executive. Two decades after his resignation, the question endures: was Tung a hapless administrator overwhelmed by crisis, or a prescient leader constrained by circumstance and an unforgiving political environment? The contrasting assessments of political scientist Sonny Lo Shiu-hing and former Central Policy Unit head Lau Siu-kai frame this debate sharply. Their divergent analyses...
body.zh: 89岁的董建华去世，促使人们对香港首任特首的遗产进行必要的反思。辞职二十年后，这个问题依然存在：董建华是一个被危机压垮的倒霉管理者，还是一个受到环境和无情政治环境限制的有先见之明的领导人？政治学家卢肇庆和前中央政策组组长刘兆佳的截然不同的评估使这场辩论尖锐化。他们的分析各有不同...

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, invites reflection on leadership and legacy. His tenure, marked by significant challenges, raises questions about governance and the impact of circumstance. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership is measured not just by outcomes, but by the commitment to act justly, love mercy, and walk...
reflection.zh: 香港首任行政長官董建華的離世，引發了對領導力和遺產的反思。他任內充滿挑戰，引發了關於管治和環境影響的疑問。彌迦書6章8節提醒我們，真正的領導力不僅以結果衡量，更在於對踐行公義、喜愛憐憫、謙和而行的承諾。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Senior official asked to resign over defective lifts at Queen Mary Hospital
title.zh: 香港：皇后医院升降机故障，高官被要求辞职

summary.en: A senior Hong Kong government official overseeing faulty lift installations that delayed the opening of a new block at Queen Mary Hospital was asked to resign last month. This action was taken to hold her accountable for defects and delays on multiple projects. However, experts criticized the handling of the civil...
summary.zh: 香港一名负责皇后医院新翼楼升降机安装工程出现故障、导致项目延误的高级政府官员，上月被要求辞职。此举旨在追究其在多个项目上出现的缺陷和延误的责任。然而，专家批评当局处理公务员管理失误的方式缺乏透明度，绕过了既定的纪律程序。

body.en: A senior Hong Kong government official who oversaw faulty lift installation work that stalled the launch of a new block at Queen Mary Hospital was asked to resign and left her post last month to take responsibility for the defects and delays on other projects, the South China Morning Post has learned. But experts criticised the authorities’ handling of civil service management missteps, which bypassed the established disciplinary mechanism, saying it lacked transparency. Multiple sources said...
body.zh: 据《南华早报》获悉，一名香港政府高级官员上个月因监督电梯安装工作出现问题而导致玛丽医院新大楼的启动陷入停滞，并被要求辞职，并为其他项目的缺陷和延误承担责任。但专家批评当局绕过既定纪律机制处理公务员管理失误，缺乏透明度。多个消息来源称...

reflection.en: Accountability for public service failures is essential. When projects falter and public trust is strained, leaders are called to take responsibility. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide all public officials.
reflection.zh: 公共服务失误的问责至关重要。当项目出现问题、公众信任受到影响时，领导者被要求承担责任。《弥迦书》6章8节提醒我们，真正的领导力在于秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则应指导所有公务员。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Animal NGO urges Hongkogners to shun gov’t-backed equestrian show Cavalluna
title.zh: 动物非营利组织敦促香港人抵制政府支持的马术表演Cavalluna

summary.en: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals Asia (PETA) has urged Hongkongers to boycott the live equestrian theatrical show Cavalluna at the Kai Tak Arena, citing allegations of animal cruelty. The show, which features 54 horses and runs until Sunday, is hosted by the Hong Kong Jockey Club.
summary.zh: 亚洲善待动物组织（PETA）已敦促香港市民抵制在启德体育馆举行的现场马术表演Cavalluna，理由是涉及虐待动物的指控。该表演有54匹马参与，将持续至周日，并由香港赛马会主办。

body.en: People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals Asia (PETA) has urged Hongkongers to shun a live equestrian theatrical show at the Kai Tak Arena, citing animal cruelty allegations. Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld. Photo: Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld. Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld debuted on Tuesday and runs until Sunday, with the Hong Kong Jockey Club as the main host and event partner. The immersive show from Europe involves 54 horses, stunts, dancing and large sets. In a statement on Thursday, a PETA Asia spokesperson said: “Horses are sensitive, intelligent animals who feel fear and pain—not entertainment props to be trotted out under blinding lights and fireworks for a paying crowd.” Underprivileged, youth and elderly groups attend the Cavalluna dress rehearsal with assistance from the Hong Kong Jockey Club. Photo: Hong Kong Jockey Club. “A PETA Germany investigation into Cavalluna documented horses being forced into the painful, welfare-violating ‘rollkur’ head-and-neck position and driven with whip-cracks into frightening tricks involving fire and light effects,” they added. The NGO called on the public to reject “spectacles that exploit animals and to choose only animal-free entertainment.” PETA Germany footage appearing to show a Cavalluna horse adopting the “rollkur” head-and-neck position. Photo: PETA Germany. PETA Germany released video clips last year appearing to show Cavalluna horses repeatedly enduring painful overstretching of the neck, restrictions in sight and breathing, and involvement in tricks involving fire and light. The whistle-blower footage was submitted to the Berlin Public Prosecutor’s Office as part of a criminal complaint alleging animal welfare violations. Horses ‘part of the family’ Cavalluna previously responded to PETA Germany on its website, saying animal welfare is its highest priority: “You cannot force a horse to perform gracefully and willingly — not with coercion, food deprivation, or any other methods that violate animal welfare. It is simply impossible to present a horse in liberty work or any other riding discipline if the animal is not willing to cooperate… If a horse were scared or suffering, even a layperson could easily see it in its body language and expression.” Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld. Photo: Hong Kong Jockey Club. They said that animal welfare representatives and independent official veterinarians examine all animals, tents, transport vehicles and riding gear worldwide, adding that Cavalluna horses are stallions which “enjoy presenting themselves.” In a response on Friday to HKFP, Cavalluna said “Short video clips or photographs can never...
body.zh: 亚洲善待动物组织（PETA）以虐待动物指控为由，敦促香港人不要在启德体育馆观看现场马术表演。卡瓦卢纳——通往另一个世界的大门。照片：卡瓦卢纳——通往另一个世界的大门。卡瓦卢纳——通往异世界之门于周二首次亮相，一直持续到周日，由香港赛马会作为主要主办方和活动合作伙伴。来自欧洲的沉浸式表演涉及 54 匹马、特技、舞蹈和大型布景。在周四的一份声明中，亚洲善待动物组织的一位发言人表示：“马是敏感、聪明的动物，它们能感受到恐惧和痛苦，而不是在炫目的灯光和烟花下为付费人群展示的娱乐道具。”弱势群体、青少年和长者团体在香港赛马会的协助下参加卡瓦卢纳彩排。照片：香港赛马会。他们补充说：“善待动物组织德国对卡瓦卢纳的一项调查记录了马匹被迫做出痛苦的、违反福利的‘rollkur’头颈姿势，并用鞭子抽打，进行涉及火焰和灯光效果的可怕技巧。”该非政府组织呼吁公众拒绝“剥削动物的景象，只选择无动物的娱乐活动”。德国善待动物组织的镜头显示，一匹卡瓦卢纳马采用“rollkur”头颈姿势。照片：善待动物组织德国。德国善待动物组织去年发布的视频片段似乎显示卡瓦卢纳马反复忍受颈部过度拉伸的痛苦、视力和呼吸的限制以及涉及火和光的技巧。举报人的视频已作为指控侵犯动物福利的刑事诉讼的一部分提交给柏林检察官办公室。马匹是“家庭的一部分”，卡瓦卢纳此前在其网站上对德国善待动物组织做出回应，称动物福利是其最优先考虑的事项：“你不能强迫马优雅而自愿地表现——不能通过胁迫、剥夺食物或任何其他侵犯动物福利的方法。如果动物不愿意合作，那么根本不可能让马进行自由工作或任何其他骑术纪律……如果一匹马感到害怕或痛苦，即使是外行人也可以很容易地从它的肢体语言和表情中看出这一点。”卡瓦卢纳——通往另一个世界的大门。照片：香港赛马会。他们说，动物福利代表和独立的官方兽医检查了世界各地的所有动物、帐篷、运输车辆和骑行装备，并补充说卡瓦卢纳马是“喜欢展示自己”的种马。卡瓦卢纳在周五对 HKFP 的回应中表示：“短视频片段或照片永远无法......

reflection.en: The PETA Asia spokesperson's statement that "Horses are sensitive, intelligent animals who feel fear and pain—not entertainment props" speaks to the vulnerability of creatures who cannot advocate for themselves. This echoes the call in Proverbs to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights." The plea to shun the Cavalluna show...
reflection.zh: 亚洲善待动物组织发言人称“马匹是敏感、聪明的动物，它们会感到恐惧和痛苦——而不是被当作娱乐道具”，这呼应了《箴言》中“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦无依的人伸张正义”的呼吁。抵制Cavalluna表演的呼吁，正是为那些可能默默忍受痛苦的动物发声的倡导行为。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘People will be shocked and angry’: Relatives, friends of jailed Tiananmen activists decry ‘unjust’ sentences
title.zh: “人们会感到震惊和愤怒”：被监禁的“六四”活动人士的亲友谴责“不公正”的判决

summary.en: Relatives of three Tiananmen vigil activists sentenced on Friday for inciting subversion have decried their years-long prison terms as “totally unjust,” and have said that two of the defendants will appeal. Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic...
summary.zh: 周五，三名参与“六四”守夜活动的活动人士因煽动颠覆国家政权罪被判处多年监禁，他们的亲属对此判决表示“完全不公正”，并称其中两人将提出上诉。已解散的“香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会”的领导人李卓人被判处七年监禁，周汉鼎被判处七年零三个月监禁。该联盟的另一位领导人何俊仁是三人中唯一认罪的人，被判处十二个月监禁。

body.en: Relatives of three Tiananmen vigil activists sentenced on Friday for inciting subversion have decried their years-long prison terms as “totally unjust,” and have said that two of the defendants will appeal. Elizabeth Tang (second from left), mother of Chow (middle) and Lau Ka-yee (first from right) met the press after sentences on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung, leaders of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China, were handed jail terms of seven years and seven years and three months, respectively. Fellow Alliance leader Albert Ho, the only one of the trio to plead guilty, received a sentence of five years and two months. The Alliance, which was also convicted and fined HK$1.5 million, held annual vigils to remember China’s 1989 Tiananmen crackdown. Elizabeth Tang outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building on Friday, September 11, 2026, ahead of the sentencing of Tiananmen vigil activists Chow Hang-tung, Albert Ho, and her husband Lee Cheuk-yan. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Lee’s wife, Elizabeth Tang, told reporters outside the West Kowloon Law Courts Building that the sentence, delivered by a panel of designated national security judges, was “unacceptable.” “It’s a sad day for me as his wife,” Tang said in Cantonese. “I cannot imagine that he has to spend another three years in jail.” “People will be shocked and angry,” she added. “Millions of people were there in Victoria Park [for the vigil].” Family members and friends of Tiananmen vigil activists meet the press on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Tang said Chow and Lee intend to launch an appeal against their convictions and sentences. June 4th memories ‘reopened’ Chow Hang-tung’s mother, who declined to give her name to press, said on Friday that her daughter was proud to represent herself in court. “She once said: ‘It feels great, I can finally take off my barrister’s robe and speak the truth freely on my own behalf’,” Chow’s mother recalled her daughter saying. Mother of Chow Hang-tung meets the press on September 11, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP, “I don’t know whether I should thank those who dragged her to the dock,” Chow’s mother said. “Thanks to them, the memories of June 4th were reopened. Thanks to them, the truth of June 4th and everything that has happened in Hong Kong over these years has been entered into Hong Kong court records.” The Tiananmen crackdown occurred on June 4, 1989, ending months of student-led demonstrations in China. It is estimated that hundreds, perhaps thousands, died when the People’s...
body.zh: 周五因煽动颠覆罪被判刑的三名天安门守夜活动人士的亲属谴责他们长达数年的监禁“完全不公正”，并表示其中两名被告将上诉。 2026 年 9 月 11 日，周先生（中）和刘嘉儿（右一）的母亲邓丽君（左二）在宣判后会见媒体。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。现已解散的香港爱国民主运动联盟领导人李卓人和周恒东分别被判处七年和七年零三个月徒刑。联盟领导人何俊仁是三人中唯一认罪的人，被判处五年零两个月的徒刑。该联盟也被定罪并被罚款 150 万港元，该联盟每年都会举行守夜活动，以纪念中国 1989 年的天安门镇压。 2026 年 9 月 11 日星期五，伊丽莎白·唐在西九龙法院大楼外，天安门守夜活动人士周恒东、何俊仁和她的丈夫李卓人即将被判刑。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。李的妻子伊丽莎白·唐(Elizabeth Tang)在西九龙法院大楼外告诉记者，由指定的国家安全法官组成的小组做出的判决“令人无法接受”。 “作为他的妻子，这对我来说是悲伤的一天，”唐用广东话说道。 “我无法想象他还要在监狱里再呆三年。” “人们会感到震惊和愤怒，”她补充道。 “数百万人在维多利亚公园[守夜]。”天安门守夜活动人士的家人和朋友于 2026 年 9 月 11 日与媒体会面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐说，周和李打算对他们的定罪和判刑提出上诉。 6 月 4 日的记忆“重新开启”周恒东的母亲拒绝向媒体透露姓名，她周五表示，她的女儿很自豪能够在法庭上代表自己。 “她曾经说过：‘感觉太棒了，我终于可以脱掉律师的袍子，代表我自己自由地说出真相了’，”周妈妈回忆女儿说。周恒东的母亲于 2026 年 9 月 11 日会见媒体。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP，“我不知道是否应该感谢那些把她拖到被告席上的人，”周恒东的母亲说。 “感谢他们，重新开​​启了6月4日的记忆。感谢他们，6月4日的真相以及这些年香港发生的一切都被载入了香港法庭记录。”天安门镇压发生于 1989 年 6 月 4 日，结束了中国学生领导的数月示威活动。据估计，当人民...

reflection.en: The families of Lee Cheuk-yan, Chow Hang-tung, and Albert Ho are calling their sentences “totally unjust.” This echoes the ancient cry for justice, a fundamental theme in scripture. May Yahweh hear their plea and may righteousness prevail, flowing like a mighty river through the courts and into society.
reflection.zh: 李卓人、周汉鼎和何俊仁的家属称他们的判决“完全不公正”。这呼应了古老的对公义的呼求，这是圣经中的一个基本主题。愿雅伟垂听他们的祈求，愿公义如大河奔腾，流淌在法庭和社会之中。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。
